channel.title: Coastal Eventures: upcoming events
channel.description: The next 40 dated events on the Gulf Coast.

item.title: 2026 Gulf Coast Clash High School Wrestling Tournament (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Friday 11/20 and Saturday 11/21 · times to be announced | Mobile Convention Center | No published price. The 8th annual Gulf Coast Clash, presented by the Mobile Sports Authority, fills the Mobile Convention Center on Friday, November 20 and Saturday, November 21. The tournament has an Elite bracket and a regular varsity bracket. Teams come from across the southeastern United States, including multiple defending state champions.

item.title: Adventure Zone at Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Mon-Sat through Dec 12 · weekdays 12 PM to 5 PM and Saturdays 9 AM to 5 PM from Nov 20 | Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm | from $19.45. Steve's Farm has rebranded as Steve's Fishing and Adventure Farm and opened a fall attraction in Walnut Hill with a corn maze, a giant slide, a kids' zipline, a jump pad, hayrides, a wagon train, a sunflower field and a pumpkin patch. It suits a family with small children who want a half day outdoors. The farm's ticket page lists day passes at $15.00 to $19.45 and a $35 season pass, so check it for each day's hours before driving out.

item.title: Annual Tree Lighting at Downtown OWA (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Saturday 11/21 · time not yet posted | Downtown OWA | No published price. OWA Parks & Resort kicks off its holiday season with the Annual Tree Lighting in Downtown OWA on November 21. The Christmas at OWA page also lists Christmas fireworks, a Very Merry Tree Walk and a Christmas projection show that lights up the downtown buildings each night. The page gives no start time or price for the tree lighting yet, so check it before you drive to Foley.

item.title: Buzzcut at Bamboo Willie's (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Saturday 11/21 | Bamboo Willie's | No published price. Bamboo Willie's books live music on the Quietwater Boardwalk, and Buzzcut plays Saturday 11/21. The bar looks out over Santa Rosa Sound on Pensacola Beach. The venue's music page does not list a start time, so call before you go. The page does not print a cover charge or a kids policy.

item.title: Cackles and Tassels: Comedy Meets Burlesque (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Saturday 11/21 · 7:00 PM (doors 6:00 PM) | Crescent Theater | No published price. Cackles and Tassels pairs stand-up from Josephine Rivera and Olivia Searcy with burlesque by Roux LaLa and Ember Alert. The Crescent Theater began as a burlesque house in the late 1800s, and this show brings that history back with a comic twist. The show is for ages 18 and up.

item.title: Coastal Christmas Market at the Orange Beach Event Center (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Saturday 11/21 · 10:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Sunday 11/22 · 10:00 AM to 4:00 PM | Orange Beach Event Center at The Wharf | No published price. The Coastal Alabama Business Chamber runs a two-day indoor holiday market at the Orange Beach Event Center, with vendors selling unique gift items. Parking is in the main Event Center lot at The Wharf. The chamber's page describes it as a Christmas tradition returned to the heart of the Alabama Gulf Coast.

item.title: Creek Fest 2026 (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Saturday 11/21 · Sunday 11/22 | Santa Rosa Band of the Lower Muscogee Tribal Grounds | No published price. Creek Fest is the Santa Rosa Band of the Lower Muscogee's two day festival on its tribal grounds in Milton, with Native American entertainment, pow wow dancing and traditional crafts. Families can spend a full day watching dance and learning about Muscogee culture. The band has not published an admission price yet, so check its page before driving out.

item.title: Family Beach Pictures with Santa at Barrancas Beach (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Saturday 11/21 · time not published | Barrancas Beach, NAS Pensacola | No published price. Navy MWR offers family photos with Santa against a beach backdrop at Barrancas Beach on Saturday, November 21. The events page invites the whole family to make holiday memories.

item.title: Finding Neverland at Joe Jefferson Playhouse (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Fridays and Saturdays 7:30 PM · Sundays 2:30 PM | Joe Jefferson Playhouse | from $26.75. Joe Jefferson Players stage Finding Neverland, the musical about playwright J.M. Barrie and how he came to write Peter Pan. Shows run three weekends, Friday and Saturday evenings and Sunday afternoons. Tickets are $26.75.

item.title: Game Days at Marina Bar & Grill (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Saturdays (college football) and Sundays (NFL), plus select Monday and Thursday nights | Marina Bar & Grill, Sandestin Golf and Beach Resort | No published price. Marina Bar & Grill at Baytowne Marina runs its own Game Days program, showing NCAA football on Saturdays and NFL games on Sundays plus select Monday and Thursday nights. It sits right on the marina at Sandestin.

item.title: Harvest Festival at the Coastal Alabama Farmers and Fishermen's Market (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Saturday 11/21 | Coastal Alabama Farmers and Fishermen's Market | No published price. The market holds its Harvest Festival on the Saturday before Thanksgiving so shoppers can stock up for the feast. The day includes the Little Miss Harvest Queen Pageant for Baldwin County students in grades 3 to 5, with interviews starting at 10:30 AM. The market is open Saturdays from 9 AM to 2 PM. The festival's own start time and any admission price are not posted.

item.title: Ice skating rink presented by Pepsi at The Wharf (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Daily from 11/13 · hours vary by day | The Wharf | from $16. The Wharf in Orange Beach opens a real ice rink for the holiday season on November 13 and keeps it open through January 18. Skates are provided, beginners are welcome, and a DJ plays Friday and Saturday nights from 7:00 PM to 10:00 PM. On Tuesdays through December 8 the Wharf donates $5 to Toys for Tots for each skate purchase.

item.title: Jazz Art Writers South Festival Youth Exhibit 2026 (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Nov 1 to Dec 15 · all day during branch hours, closed Sundays | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. More than fifty paintings by artists ages 8 to 18 who attend local public schools interpret jazz music at the Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library. The JAWS Festival put the exhibit together with the Mobile Arts Council and the Amp Up Arts Program, and it hangs from November 1 through December 15 during branch hours, which are Monday to Saturday.

item.title: Jubilee Renaissance Faire with Knights of Valour (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Saturday 11/21 and Sunday 11/22 · hours not published | Pensacola Interstate Fairgrounds, Midway | No published price. The Knights of Valour bring their jousting to the Jubilee Renaissance Faire on the Pensacola Interstate Fairgrounds Midway for a weekend. The fairgrounds page gives no hours, ticket price or event link. Call the fair office at (850) 944-4500 before going.

item.title: Kids Night Out at the Pensacola MESS Hall (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Friday 11/20 · 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM · Friday 12/4 · 6:00 PM to 8:00 PM | Pensacola MESS Hall | from $20. The Pensacola MESS Hall gives parents a Friday night off on November 20 and December 4. Kids in grade 1 and up spend two hours on hands-on science, games and cheese pizza. A child with a different meal in mind can bring one, and everyone should bring a water bottle.

item.title: Little Feat: The Last Farewell Tour at the Saenger Theatre (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Saturday 11/21 · doors 7:00 PM, show 8:00 PM | Saenger Theatre | from $49. Little Feat brings The Last Farewell Tour to the Saenger Theatre in downtown Mobile. The band, which began in 1969 when Frank Zappa told Lowell George to start his own group, calls the tour a retirement from the travel of touring and says it will keep performing and recording as long as it is able. Doors open at 7 PM and the show starts at 8 PM.

item.title: Make Your Own Glass (hot glass, by appointment) (SAT 11/21)
item.description: By appointment: Wednesdays 5 PM-9 PM, Saturdays 8 AM-11 AM | First City Art Center | from $85. Make Your Own Glass is a hands-on hot glass session at First City Art Center in Pensacola, where each participant makes a piece with a glassblower. It's for ages 8 and up including adults, by appointment on Wednesdays from 5-9 PM and Saturdays from 8-11 AM. The finished piece cools in an annealing oven and is picked up the following week. Standard pieces cost $85, and premium pieces such as a pumpkin, ornament, cup or bowl cost $110-$140.

item.title: Mobile in the Gilded Age exhibition at the History Museum of Mobile (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Monday to Saturday 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM · Sunday 1:00 PM to 5:00 PM · through 6/6/2027 | History Museum of Mobile | from $8. The History Museum of Mobile opened Mobile in the Gilded Age on October 9, 2026, and the exhibition stays up through June 6, 2027. Gowns, inventions and everyday objects show how railroads, new technology and department stores changed life in Mobile in the late 1800s and early 1900s. The exhibition also covers the unequal opportunities and segregation of the period.

item.title: Mobile Music Legends exhibit at Moorer Branch Library (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Library hours · 11/1 to 12/15 · closed Sundays | Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library | No published price. The Monte L. Moorer/Spring Hill Branch Library hosts the first annual Mobile Music Legends exhibit. The display celebrates artists and ensembles who carried the soul, jazz and spirit of the Gulf Coast to the world. The exhibit stays up from November 1 to December 15.

item.title: Moonlight Garden photography exhibition at Pensacola State College (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Through Friday 12/11 · Mon to Thu 9 AM to 5 PM, Fri 9 AM to 3 PM | Switzer Gallery, Pensacola State College | No published price. Photographer Mark Alan Francis shows landscape prints made with the Mordançage process, which gives black and white silver gelatin prints earth tones of copper, tan and burnt sienna. The pictures look like they were taken at night under moonlight. It runs in the Switzer Gallery through Friday 12/11 and is a quiet stop on a weekday.

item.title: Moonlight Garden photography exhibition by Mark Alan Francis (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Through Friday 12/11 · Weekdays | Switzer Gallery, Pensacola State College | No published price. Mark Alan Francis shows landscape photographs made with the Mordançage process, which leaves copper, tan and burnt sienna tones in black-and-white silver gelatin prints. The prints look as if they were shot at night under moonlight. The show hangs in the Switzer Gallery from November 5 through December 11.

item.title: Noises Off!: Chickasaw Civic Theatre (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Nov 12-22, 2026 · eves + matinees | Chickasaw Civic Theatre | No published price. Michael Frayn's door-slamming backstage farce, one of the funniest plays ever written, plays at Chickasaw's community playhouse.

item.title: Painting with a Twist Pensacola: paint-and-sip, family paint days and date nights (weekly programme) (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Classes most days: family days Saturday 10:30 AM, brunch Sunday 11 AM, evenings Wednesday to Saturday | Painting with a Twist Pensacola | $35 per family. Painting with a Twist Pensacola is an artist-led paint-and-sip studio at 4771 Bayou Blvd Suite C11 with several classes every week. October has family paint days (ages 6 and up with a parent, no alcohol), adult Paint & Sip and Date Night classes (ages 16 and up on date nights), Halloween-themed canvases and Paint Your Pet. Classes cost $35-$60 depending on the class, and alcohol is sold on site with no BYOB.

item.title: Pensacola Invitational: Four-Team College Basketball Tournament (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Sat 11/21 at 4 PM and 7 PM, Sun 11/22 at 2 PM and 5 PM | Pensacola Bay Center | from $15.71. The Pensacola Invitational brings Southern Miss, Troy, Valparaiso and Nicholls State to the Bay Center for a two day, winner takes all tournament. Games are Saturday at 4:00 and 7:00 PM and Sunday at 2:00 and 5:00 PM. Doors open one hour before the first game each day.

item.title: Photos with Santa at The Wharf (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Fridays to Sundays 11/13 to 12/24 · Fri 3 PM to 6 PM, Sat 10 AM to 6 PM, Sun 12 PM to 6 PM | The Wharf | No published price. The Wharf in Orange Beach sets up Photos with Santa on Fridays through Sundays from November 13 to December 24. Friday hours run 3:00 PM to 6:00 PM, Saturday 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM and Sunday 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM. The Wharf sells various price packages, and the ice rink sits next door at the same property.

item.title: Pirates Murder Mystery Dinner Theatre (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Sat 11/21/2026 · Doors 6:00 PM · Show 7:00 PM | Heritage Hall at Seville Quarter | from $69. This pirate-crew whodunit downtown includes dinner, a cast working the tables, and a mystery that unfolds between courses. It is very Pensacola, and a good one to dress for.

item.title: Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Thursdays 3 PM-8 PM and Saturdays 12 PM-2 PM | GameMasters Guild | Free. Pokémon League at GameMasters Guild is free casual play for the Pokémon TCG, the Pokémon Champions video game and Pokémon GO. It runs Thursdays from 3 to 8 PM and Saturdays from 12 to 2 PM in Crestview. All ages are welcome, and the shop calls it a family-friendly space. Players get promo cards or special items while supplies last, and a free Pokémon account is needed to qualify (children under 13 register under a parent's account).

item.title: PSC Annual Holiday Art Market (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Friday 11/20 · 12:00 PM to 6:00 PM · Monday 11/23 and Tuesday 11/24 · 11:00 AM to 1:00 PM | Switzer Gallery, Pensacola State College | No published price. Pensacola State College holds its annual Holiday Art Market in the Switzer Gallery in Building 15. It opens Friday afternoon and again for two short midday sessions on Monday and Tuesday of Thanksgiving week. PSC's pages give no description or price, and the campus line is (850) 484-2544.

item.title: Public Ice Skating at the Pensacola Bay Center, November sessions (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Nov 1 to Nov 25 · one hour sessions, see dates | Pensacola Bay Center | from $15. The Pensacola Bay Center opens its ice for one-hour public skate sessions. The November sessions run Sunday 11/1 at 6:30 PM, Saturday 11/7 and Sunday 11/8 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, Friday 11/13 and Saturday 11/14 at 9:30 PM, Sunday 11/15 at 1:30, 3:00 and 4:30 PM, and Wednesday 11/25 at 9:30 PM. The Bay Center states that all sessions are subject to change.

item.title: Qigong classes at Historic Blakeley (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Saturday 11/7 · 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM · Saturday 11/21 · 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM | Historic Blakeley State Park | from $10. Historic Blakeley State Park offers guided Qigong, a slow, low-impact practice that combines movement, deep breathing and visualization and is described as an ancestor of Tai Chi. Classes run from 9:00 AM to 10:00 AM on Saturday 11/7 and Saturday 11/21, with an optional group hike afterward. They take place rain or shine unless there is lightning or severe weather.

item.title: Santa's Letters to the North Pole mailbox at Destin Commons (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Friday 11/20 · open during center hours · through Sunday 12/13 | Destin Commons | Free. Children can write a letter to Santa and drop it in the North Pole mailbox on South Street, in front of Chipotle. Every child who submits a letter is entered to win a family staycation package. The mailbox is up from November 20 through December 13.

item.title: SKECHERS Wicked Wine Run: Milton (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Sat 11/21/2026 · gates 8:30 AM · 5K at 10:30 AM · 1K tasting walk at 12:30 PM | Adventures Unlimited | $20 per vehicle. This 1K tasting walk with four wine stations, a 5K run, or both, runs through the Blackwater river property, then a party with a DJ, food trucks, and games until 2:30. It is a race where the walk is the point and nobody is timing you.

item.title: Story Time and Craft at Foley Community Library (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Tuesdays 10:00 AM and 5:30 PM · Saturdays 10:00 AM | Foley Community Library | No published price. The Foley Community Library holds a story time with a craft every Tuesday and Saturday from August through May. Tuesday sessions run at 10:00 AM and 5:30 PM, and the Saturday session runs at 10:00 AM. No age limit or price is posted.

item.title: The Comedy of Errors at Pensacola Christian College (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Thursday 11/19 and Friday 11/20 · 7:00 PM, Saturday 11/21 · 2:00 PM | Pensacola Christian College | Free. Pensacola Christian College stages Shakespeare's The Comedy of Errors, in which two sets of identical twins land in the same city and cause a chain of mistaken identities. The Fine Arts Series lists three performances. The event is free with open seating, and doors open at 6:15 PM for the evening shows.

item.title: The Highwaymen Tribute Show (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Saturday 11/21 · doors 5:00 PM, music 7:00 PM | Alabama Gulf Coast Music Hall (The Big Red Barn) | from $8. Recording artist and songwriter Steve Valdez leads a tribute to the Highwaymen, honoring Johnny Cash, Kris Kristofferson, Willie Nelson and Waylon Jennings. The Big Red Barn opens at 5 PM with food and drinks, and the music starts at 7 PM. Tickets are $8 ahead or $10 at the door.

item.title: The View Within exhibition at Blue Morning Gallery (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Sunday 10/25 to Saturday 11/28 · reception Friday 11/6 at 4:30 | Blue Morning Gallery | No published price. Blue Morning Gallery in downtown Pensacola shows The View Within, an exhibition of colorful abstract paintings by the featured artist, from October 25 through November 28. A reception on Friday November 6 at 4:30 lets visitors meet the artist, hear live music and enjoy refreshments and conversation.

item.title: Trim-a-Tree at the Foley Art Center (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Friday 11/13 to Wednesday 12/23 · daily (hours to confirm) | Foley Art Center | Free. Since 1967 the Foley Art Center has opened its Trim-a-Tree holiday show on the second Friday in November, and it runs through December 23. More than 125 local artists and craftspeople sell pottery, woodcarvings, florals, jewelry, blown glass, textiles, soy candles, wooden toys and ornaments on consignment. Admission is free.

item.title: University of Mobile Christmas Spectacular at Cottage Hill (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Thursday 11/19 to Sunday 11/22 · Thu and Fri 7:00 PM, Sat 2:00 PM, Sun 4:00 PM | Cottage Hill Baptist Church | No published price. The University of Mobile's Christmas Spectacular is an annual holiday show by students of the Alabama School of the Arts, held again at Cottage Hill Baptist Church. Carols and newer holiday songs come from choirs, a full orchestra, a jazz band, a Celtic string ensemble and several vocal groups. Tickets are sold only through the university's Christmas ticket page.

item.title: Wanda Sullivan: Bloem Exhibition (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Now through December 11 | Anna Lamar Switzer Center for Visual Arts | No published price. A gallery exhibition by artist Wanda Sullivan runs at Pensacola State College's visual arts center through mid-December. The center's own site does not publish an admission price.

item.title: White Tie Rock Ensemble: A Christmas Rock Experience at OWA (SAT 11/21)
item.description: Friday 11/20 · 7:00 PM · Saturday 11/21 · 8:30 PM after the tree lighting | Downtown OWA Theater | from $44.99. White Tie Rock Ensemble brings its holiday rock show to the Downtown OWA Theater in Foley for two nights. The Saturday show follows OWA's Christmas Tree Lighting. Tickets are required and sold through OvationTix.
